title: Make stories with us
intro: At KEMSOR Studio, every film and series starts with people who love the craft. Join a studio where writers, producers, crew, and creative minds work together, from the first draft to the final release.
reasons: Our teams take projects from development to release, so you see your work reach the screen.
Development, finance, production, post, and release work side by side under one roof.
Feature films, series, documentaries and short films, across languages and locations in India.
We hire for talent and attitude, and we help people take on bigger roles as they grow.
teams: Story, script, research and creative development.
Producers, line producers, production managers, coordinators and assistant directors.
Finance, co-productions, legal, accounts and partnerships.
Cinematography, lighting, production design, costume, hair and makeup.
Editing, VFX, sound, music and colour.
Release planning, marketing, publicity, festivals and platform partnerships.
hiring: Send your application and CV through this page.
Our team reviews every application and replies within 15 working days.
Shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview, in person or online.
For creative and technical roles, we may ask for a short task or a look at your work.
Successful candidates receive a written offer from KEMSOR Studios.
